messages.subject: INLA ERROR - Assertion failed: (arg->Q->a[0] >= 0.0)...
parts:
Hi, 

I get this error when I run the model. Version of R 4.3. See attached details after running it wit Verbose = TRUE. Can you pleaes help? I have ran other variables separately for the ZIP model and only two show the same error:

MODEL:

pois_rankoutstroth <- inla(
  n ~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym", graph=UG.adj) + recode_outstroth_fin,
  data = fmd_outbreaks,
  family = "zeroinflatedpoisson1",
  quantiles=c(0.025, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.975),
  E=Expected,
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE)
)

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA ERROR - Assertion failed: (arg->Q->a[0] >= 0.0)...
parts:
this can happen for these models. you can try with

'bym2' instead of 'bym'

(make sure you running the most recent testing version)

add

control.inla=list(cmin=0)

then you can try this

r <- inla(...)
r$.args$control.inla$cmin <- -Inf
r <- inla.rerun(r)
